title: Super Mario Kart

masks.why: the title screen's logo is laid out for 256 columns on a 32-tile map that would repeat (BG1 map at $1000)

issues: Both Mode 7 views (the track and the course map, or the two players' tracks) continue to both edges; the hills behind repeat seamlessly.
Sprites are filled in the sides: the game places the karts, shadows and items it does not show around the SNES picture, so rivals appear only in the centre 256 columns.
The title screen is shown with black sides.
No flicker: in the 6,750 frames checked the game never drew more sprites on a line than a SNES shows, so it changed nothing; it changes only lines over the limits.
Fast CPU ran the 6,750 frames checked; the attract races play differently from frame 4.

verified.how: Workshop --wms-test (E6), 6,750 frames of the attract demos (one and two players) in lockstep with the SNES console: widescreen's centre 256 columns identical to the SNES picture every frame, STAT77 and the sound identical, switched off frame-identical; no flicker changes only lines over the SNES's limits; better sound changes only the sound.
